legal_units.title: Avoidance of tax and exclusion from tonnage tax scheme.
legal_units.text: Subject to the provisions of this Part, the tonnage tax scheme shall not apply where a tonnage tax company is a party to any transaction or arrangement which amounts to an abuse of the tonnage tax scheme.

Section 234(1): Subject to the provisions of this Part, the tonnage tax scheme shall not apply where a tonnage tax company is a party to any transaction or arrangement which amounts to an abuse of the tonnage tax scheme.

legal_units.title: Avoidance of tax and exclusion from tonnage tax scheme.

legal_units.title: Avoidance of tax and exclusion from tonnage tax scheme.
legal_units.text: Where a tonnage tax company is a party to any transaction or arrangement referred to in sub-section (1), the Assessing Officer shall, by an order in writing, exclude such company from the tonnage tax scheme.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 234 Avoidance of tax and exclusion from tonnage tax scheme. Section 234(4): Where a tonnage tax company is a party to any transaction or arrangement referred to in sub-section (1), the Assessing Officer shall, by an order in writing, exclude such company from the tonnage tax scheme.

legal_units.title: Avoidance of tax and exclusion from tonnage tax scheme.
legal_units.text: The provisions of this section shall not apply where the company satisfies the Assessing Officer that the transaction or arrangement was a bona fide commercial transaction and had not been entered into for the purpose of obtaining tax advantage under this Part.

legal_units.title: Avoidance of tax and exclusion from tonnage tax scheme.
legal_units.text: Where an order has been passed under sub-section (4) by the Assessing Officer excluding the tonnage tax company from the tonnage tax scheme, the option for tonnage tax scheme shall cease to be in force from the first day of the tax year in which the transaction or arrangement was entered into.
